title: An invoice keeps its term and due date when the term is deactivated
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30 and has an invoice A dated Oct 5, 2026, due Nov 4, 2026, showing Terms Net 30.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Open invoice A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The toast "Net 30 deactivated" shows.

Step 3:

  • It still shows Terms Net 30 (the plain name) and Due date Nov 4, 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R7: “An invoice keeps the term and due date it was created with. Changing the customer's term later, deactivating the term or moving the customer never changes an existing invoice.”
